contract.fixtureAggregateAlgorithm: sha256(sorted fixture filename + NUL + exact fixture file bytes + LF)

canonicalJson.objectKeyOrdering: ascending UTF-16 code unit ordinal order

eventId.algorithm: evt_ + first 32 lowercase hex chars of SHA-256(canonical JSON of event identity material excluding schemaVersion, eventId, and occurredAt)
eventId.retryInvariant: Persist immutable eventId, event, exact canonical body, identitySha256, and bodySha256 in the durable outbox; never rebuild occurredAt or identity material. Every delivery attempt derives fresh transport headers separately.
eventId.receiverValidation: Require eventId to equal deterministicIntegrationEventV2Id(integrationEventV2IdentityMaterial(event)) after authenticated canonical-body parsing and before any receipt mutation or downstream effect.

identitySha256.purpose: logical idempotency identity shared with deterministic eventId generation

traceId.scope: one application pipeline trace spanning application, UID, video, review, and view snapshot events

deliveryAttempts.attemptRule: For every delivery attempt, generate a fresh x-scp-timestamp and HMAC signature over the unchanged canonical body using the currently configured current slot keyId and secret.
deliveryAttempts.afterFreshnessWindow: Retry the same immutable eventId and body with a new timestamp and signature; never replay a stale signed request.
deliveryAttempts.afterKeyRotation: Retry the same immutable eventId and body using the newly configured current versioned keyId and secret.

wire.canonicalBody: UTF-8 bytes of deterministic JSON with object keys sorted by ascending UTF-16 code unit ordinal order and no insignificant whitespace

requirements: mandatory uppercase Z or numeric timezone offset
hour/minute/second and offset components in range

signing.keyBytes: UTF-8 bytes of the secret selected by x-scp-key-id
messageBytesInOrder: exact canonical request body UTF-8 bytes
signing.output: sha256= followed by 64 lowercase hex HMAC bytes

headers.x-scp-content-sha256: lowercase hex SHA-256 of exact canonical event body bytes
headers.x-scp-key-id: configured stable versioned key identifier; not a slot name

keyRotation.lookup: match incoming x-scp-key-id to configured slot keyId
keyRotation.overlapRule: Verify inbound requests against both configured current and previous keyIds during overlap; every outbound delivery attempt signs with current.
keyRotation.retirementRule: Retire previous after the accepted inbound freshness/replay overlap window; durable outbox retries do not depend on old signing headers or old key material.
keyRotation.storedRequestRule: Persist and never rewrite immutable eventId, event, canonical body, identitySha256, or bodySha256. Do not persist timestamp, signature, or key headers as the retry unit. Every retry creates fresh x-scp-timestamp and x-scp-signature with the configured current versioned x-scp-key-id.

ordering: authenticate content hash, timestamp, key id, and HMAC
parse and validate the exact canonical event body shape
require x-scp-event-id to equal body eventId; reject signature_invalid before any receipt lookup
evaluate deterministic eventId; on mismatch, use read-only existing-receipt identity lookup to classify unseen invalid_event HTTP 400 versus existing changed-identity idempotency_conflict HTTP 409
guard the authenticated signature replay before any effect
check global eventId plus logical identitySha256 equality
persist the accepted receipt before any downstream effect
replay.sameSignatureWithMatchingAcceptedReceipt: exact accepted signed retry is duplicate success HTTP 200 without rerunning effects
replay.sameEventIdSameIdentityDifferentOccurred: duplicate success HTTP 200 without rerunning effects
replay.sameEventIdDifferentLogicalIdentity: after authentication, a read-only existing receipt identity lookup classifies this as idempotency_conflict HTTP 409 before replay guard, receipt mutation, or effects

idempotency.identitySha256Definition: SHA-256 of canonical JSON of event identity material excluding schemaVersion, eventId, and occurredAt
idempotency.bodySha256Definition: SHA-256 of the exact full canonical event body bytes retained only as accepted transport evidence; it is not the duplicate equality field
idempotency.deterministicReceiveGate: Before replay guard, receipt mutation, or effects, reject any eventId unequal to evt_ + first 32 lowercase hex chars of SHA-256(canonical identity material); a read-only existing receipt lookup preserves 409 conflict classification, while an unknown arbitrary eventId is invalid_event HTTP 400.

revision.scope: per eventName plus its event-specific subject identifier tuple
revision.subjectRevisionRule: revision must increase monotonically per event-scoped revision subject key

trace.traceContinuityRule: all accepted application, UID, video, review, and snapshot events for the same pipeline key keep the original traceId

videoSubmittedCanonicalUrl.receiverRule: Require exact string equality with https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=${payload.youtubeVideoId} and require payload.youtubeVideoId to equal subject.youtubeVideoId.

videoSubmittedGameId.meaning: Program title registry id (xp-hero, snake-clash, ...). Portal sends the id the submitter chose; Flu reads an absent value as the program default title (xp-hero) and an unknown id as the default title flagged for human review (gameIdUnresolved).

forbiddenCategories.patternSemantics: email-looking local-part@domain.tld substring in a free-text value
case-insensitive Bearer plus whitespace plus token-looking credential substring
bare contiguous 8-20 digit run in a free-text value; UID-labelled numeric content is also rejected by runtime validation

futureFreeTextFieldRule.adoptionRule: Schema additionalProperties remains false; a future free-text field cannot be adopted until schema and runtime privacy validation both cover it.

privacy.receiverObligation: After authentication, enforce schema and runtime privacy validation before any receipt or effect; reject an explicit forbidden category fail-closed.

runtimeSchemaParity.schemaRule: Every present v2 free-text wire field references #/$defs/freeTextPrivacy; structured strings retain their dedicated allowlist patterns.
runtimeSchemaParity.limitation: These explicit patterns do not detect every possible secret and must not be described as a general secret scanner.

tokenEncoding.payloadJsonBytes: UTF-8 bytes of a JSON object containing exactly the canonicalFields set; no additional fields are allowed
tokenEncoding.payloadBase64url: RFC 4648 base64url without padding of the exact payloadJsonBytes
tokenEncoding.signingBytes: ASCII/UTF-8 bytes of payloadBase64url exactly as present before the period
tokenEncoding.signatureKey: shared versioned outreach secret selected by payload.keyId
tokenEncoding.signatureBase64url: RFC 4648 base64url without padding of the 32-byte HMAC output

expiry.expiredOrTooFarFuture: invalid token; bind no canonical identifiers or trace

keyRotation.keyIdMeaning: stable versioned outreach key identifier, not an implicit slot name

portalEnvironmentFields.currentKeyId: SCP_OUTREACH_HMAC_KEY_ID (required with SCP_OUTREACH_HMAC_SECRET in production; only non-production literal current may omit it)

keyRotation.issuer: sign with the configured current keyId and its shared outreach secret
keyRotation.verifier: resolve only exact configured current or previous keyIds during overlap
keyRotation.collisionRule: fail closed when configured current and previous keyIds are identical; do not try either secret
keyRotation.localFallback: allowed only for the explicit keyId current in non-production; previous and arbitrary keyIds never receive fallback material
keyRotation.retirement: remove previous only after every token it signed has expired

normalizationOrder: trim leading and trailing Unicode whitespace
require 3-254 characters and a single email-shaped local@domain value without whitespace
expectedEmailBinding.key: the same shared versioned outreach secret selected by keyId for the token signature
expectedEmailBinding.output: literal v2_ plus RFC 4648 base64url without padding of the 32-byte HMAC output
expectedEmailBinding.domainSeparation: the context plus NUL separator prevents reuse as a token signature or any Portal application-identity HMAC
expectedEmailBinding.mismatchRule: retain outreach=different evidence, but do not persist verifiedOutreach and do not bind campaignId, outreachId, or token traceId

validationOrder: split into exactly two non-empty base64url segments and enforce the 2048-character payload bound plus 43-character signature
base64url-decode payload and parse one non-array JSON object
select canonical v2 when any of programId, campaignId, or traceId is present; require the exact canonical field set
validate purpose and safe keyId sufficiently to resolve a key
resolve exact current/previous keyId and verify token signature with constant-time equality; unknown keys fail closed
validate expiresAt safe-integer millisecond window, identifier/trace formats, and v2 expectedEmailHmac format
require token programId to equal the Apply programId
derive expectedEmailHmac from the normalized submitted email and the selected outreach secret and compare in constant time
only after every prior gate persist verifiedOutreach and allow branded v2 producers to bind campaignId, outreachId, and the unchanged token traceId

legacyCompatibility.behavior: legacy signed envelopes may retain match/different analytics and legacy UTM behavior
legacyCompatibility.expectedEmailHmac: legacy v1_ Portal application identity HMAC
legacyCompatibility.separateSecretFallback: legacy verification may retain its prior Portal application-HMAC fallback; canonical v2 never uses it

privacyAndFailure.browserExchange: GET /apply removes every decoded outreach query parameter before render and places one bounded token in a short-lived HttpOnly SameSite=Strict cookie scoped to /api/public/applications
privacyAndFailure.rawTokenStorage: forbidden in application, event, outbox, receipt, audit, analytics, Sheets, logs, rendered HTML, and RSC payloads
privacyAndFailure.transientInputOnly: the raw token may exist only in the redirect Set-Cookie exchange, the scoped request cookie, and in-memory public submission verification
privacyAndFailure.invalidToken: public Apply remains available; outreach=unknown and canonical identifiers/trace are omitted
privacyAndFailure.validEmailMismatch: public Apply remains available; outreach=different and canonical identifiers/trace are omitted
privacyAndFailure.programMismatch: public Apply remains available; outreach=unknown and canonical identifiers/trace are omitted

campaignId.producerBehavior: Portal v2 durable producers include campaignId only through the branded verifiedOutreach token boundary after exact-envelope, signature, expiry, key-id, identifier, traceId, Apply programId, and normalized expected-email HMAC verification; arbitrary subject and UTM candidates are removed.

outreachId.producerBehavior: Portal v2 durable producers include outreachId only through the branded verifiedOutreach token boundary after exact-envelope, signature, expiry, key-id, identifier, traceId, Apply programId, and normalized expected-email HMAC verification; outreachIdHmac, arbitrary subject, and UTM candidates are removed.

identifierMapping.fixtureContract: All six canonical cross-system fixtures include campaignId=campaign-summer and outreachId=outreach-001. Portal runtime producers include those optional identifiers only from a verified outreach token v2 whose programId equals the Apply programId and whose expectedEmailHmac matches the normalized submitted email.
identifierMapping.schemaAllowance: The optional subject fields remain unchanged in schema.json and are populated only through the verified outreach-token producer boundary.

portalVideoDeliveryG007.boundaryLabel: Portal producer/delivery worker only; no Flu receiver implementation
portalVideoDeliveryG007.uidGuideEligibility: Only Portal-produced uid.guide-email.requested with payload.deliveryReason=resend; initial guide and every other Portal event fail closed.
portalVideoDeliveryG007.endpointRule: configured HTTPS endpoint without credentials, query, or fragment

receiptResponse.bindingRule: eventId, identitySha256, and bodySha256 must exactly match the revalidated immutable outbox; acceptedAt is strict RFC3339 and not earlier than createdAt

leaseSafety.clockRule: renewal, signing, and completion each read a fresh current clock; scheduler start time is not reused
leaseSafety.casRule: renewal and completion require exact owner, expiry, attempt, and delivery revision and reject expired leases

legacyVideoIntakeCompatibility.drainRule: legacy leasing excludes v2_owned; older unmarked candidates are cross-checked by videoSubmissionId against the v2 video.submitted outbox, converted to v2_owned, and skipped; the sender rejects the ownership marker before request construction

portalVideoDeliveryG007.resend: G006 queued requests are separately CAS-leased and consumed against the same immutable event; receipt history is append-only and the original delivered receipt remains intact

scheduler.authentication: Google Scheduler OIDC with exact direct Cloud Run audience, caller service account, job resource, and bounded schedule time

portalVideoDeliveryG007.localHarnessLabel: Portal-local HTTP receiver harness; not Flu; not final Portal-Flu E2E

uidGuideDeliveryMaterial.boundaryLabel: Portal boundary — private material retrieval only; not Flu implementation
uidGuideDeliveryMaterial.callAfter: Portal has durably persisted state=delivered plus the exact hash-bound Flu accepted receipt for the immutable Portal-produced uid.guide-email.requested event with payload.deliveryReason=resend

authentication.signatureMessage: x-scp-timestamp + LF + x-scp-idempotency-key + LF + exact raw JSON request body
authentication.identityRule: x-scp-idempotency-key, x-scp-event-id, and body.eventId must be the same accepted eventId

requestBody.subjectRule: applicationId and uidGrantId must exactly equal the stored event.subject values

deliveryStateContract.producerCompatibility: Current Portal video and Admin UID-resend producers continue to create the existing exact delivery_queued record; immutable event, body, ids, and hashes are not rebuilt during later delivery transitions.

immutableIdentityBody.validation: Validate deterministic eventId, canonical body, schemaVersion, both SHA-256 bindings, createdAt=event.occurredAt, exact event keys/types/timestamps, and the integration-event privacy denylist independently from delivery state.

bindings.eventId: must exactly equal outbox.id and outbox.event.eventId
bindings.identitySha256: must exactly equal outbox.identitySha256 after immutable event revalidation
bindings.bodySha256: must exactly equal outbox.bodySha256 after canonical body revalidation

fluReceipt.acceptedAt: strict RFC3339 date-time not earlier than outbox.createdAt
fluReceipt.sensitiveMaterial: forbidden; receipt is metadata-only and may not contain recipient, UID, bearer, URL, authorization, secret, body copy, or provider message content

portalAuthorization: load the outbox document by eventId
revalidate immutable identity/body fields independently from delivery state
require the exact delivered record keys and metadata-only fluReceipt bound to eventId, identitySha256, bodySha256, and an acceptedAt timestamp not earlier than createdAt
deny submitted, delivery_queued, leased, retryable_failed, dead_letter, malformed delivered, or tampered delivered records
allow only source=portal, eventName=uid.guide-email.requested, and deliveryReason=resend
require the exact matching application program/locale and issued, unexpired replacement grant for scp-application-onboarding-v1
deny original, superseded, consumed, revoked, expired, cross-application, or mismatched grants

successResponse.uidGuideUrlProfile: absolute Portal URL with exact path /onboarding/uid and only the opaque grant query parameter

uidGuideDeliveryMaterial.idempotency: A valid retry for the same accepted event and exact request returns the same grant material while the Portal release audit is created at most once; a stale signature or changed identity/body is denied.

genericDenial.appliesTo: wrong event/grant/application/header, stale or tampered HMAC, cookie, bearer, malformed body, unavailable configuration, and inactive grant

safePersistentEvidence: state=delivered and the exact metadata-only hash-bound Flu receipt

uidGuideDeliveryMaterial.fluImplementation: outside this Portal handoff; Flu owns receiver acceptance, mail rendering, outbox, transport, retry, and delivery audit, while Portal G007 may persist only the defined metadata-only accepted receipt on the existing immutable outbox record

portalCallbackReceiverG008.implementationBoundary: Portal receiver only; no Flu receiver, producer, collector, review, or adapter implementation

endpoint.transport: HTTPS only; optional x-forwarded-proto must be https
endpoint.rateLimiting: bounded pre-auth global and post-auth key-slot rate limits; no event body or secret is used as the limiter key

requiredPortalRecords: scp_integration_event_v2_outbox delivered video.submitted with hash-bound Flu accepted receipt
authoritativeJoin.reviewIdRule: the first authenticated, fully joined review event establishes the reviewId; every later review or snapshot must match it exactly
authoritativeJoin.trackingIdRule: the first accepted approved snapshot establishes the trackingId; every later snapshot must match it exactly
authoritativeJoin.failure: HTTP 409 without receipt, audit, subject head, pipeline head, current projection, or G006 evidence mutation

durability.transaction: one Firestore transaction/CAS spans replay, event receipt, subject revision, pipeline trace, current review/snapshot, G006 evidence, and append-only audit
durability.eventId: immutable global key; same logical identity is duplicate success and changed identity is HTTP 409
durability.signatureReplay: an accepted identical signed retry resolves only through its matching durable receipt; unmatched reuse is HTTP 409
durability.revision: strictly monotonic per frozen event-specific subject; stale or equal-different revision is HTTP 409
durability.trace: the application pipeline traceId is immutable across video, review, and snapshot

reviewRule.nonApprovedTransition: immediately removes view snapshot fields from creator/Admin evidence and marks retained safe snapshot history as suppressed

snapshotRule.acceptWhen: payload.reviewStatus=approved and co-stored current authoritative review is approved for the exact video, reviewId, trackingId continuity, and traceId

localHarness.label: Portal-only signed callback route and Firestore emulator harness; no Flu implementation; not final joint E2E

finalJointE2E.required: Flu adopts the frozen schema/fixtures and implements its producer/collector/review boundary in a separate Flu-owned session before joint live E2E

creator.channel-verified.createOnceAxis: canonical JSON array of [eventName, subject.programId, subject.applicationId, subject.portalCreatorId]
creator.channel-verified.portalEmissionLedger: Portal queues at most one channel-verified event per portalCreatorId for all time, so a later re-verification against a different channel never produces a second event on this axis
creator.channel-verified.portalEmissionFlag: SCP_CREATOR_CHANNEL_VERIFIED_EVENT_ENABLED, default off until Flu has deployed its receiver for this event name

portalOwns: Portal private uid.guide-email.requested resend material retrieval boundary
Portal signed durable callback receiver for review and view snapshot events
boundaries.fluImplementation: Flu callback producer, review, collector, and adapter implementation is outside Portal G008 and pending separate Flu SHA adoption.
boundaries.localHarnessLabel: Portal-local integration-event-v2 harness; non-Flu implementation; non-final joint E2E

finalJointE2E.requiredBeforeFinal: Run joint Portal-to-Flu and Flu-to-Portal E2E after separate Flu SHA adoption of this schema and fixture aggregate.
